## What's new

- Apps and Bookshelf keep their four-column grids. App rows are tighter, while Bookshelf uses wider cover spacing and consistently positioned author lines. Folder dialogs still use three columns.
- Browsing a local folder no longer moves it to the front of Bookshelf. A folder's position reflects the most recently opened book inside it, including books in subfolders. Bookshelf refreshes preserve the visible position.
- Home keeps Continue Reading prominent, and Settings uses full-width rows grouped by purpose. About keeps its layout and is hidden by default unless enabled in Settings.
- An update APK that has already been downloaded can be installed without downloading it again after its size, hash, version, and signature are verified.
